states.name: Indiana
states.label: 748 official locations linked to public camera players
states.notes: 749 public entries were retrieved from the same anonymous metadata query used by TrafficWise. 748 authoritative points are mapped and linked to their official per-camera player. One official point falls outside Indiana and is withheld without guessing a correction. Video is not embedded or rehosted. The separate XML developer feed requires credentials; ordinary viewing and this factual location catalog do not.
states.note: 748 mapped camera locations link directly to official players; one source entry has an invalid location.

states.name: Iowa
states.label: No-credential GIS camera data exists; image reuse scope needs clarification
states.notes: Iowa DOT expressly supplies no-credential camera GIS feeds and encourages integrators. Current terms dedicate GIS data to CC0 but separately restrict copying/republication of website Content including camera imagery. Camera metadata licensing alone was not treated as a grant to embed all referenced image pixels.

statusDefinitions.permitted-embed: Provider explicitly permits embedding its own map; no extracted camera catalog
statusDefinitions.integrated: Documented free no-key catalog and reuse terms accepted for included official images
statusDefinitions.key-required: The documented developer feed requires an access key; alternative feeds unverified
statusDefinitions.official-map-only: Use the official public camera map; no reusable no-key geolocated catalog verified
statusDefinitions.legal-uncertain: Public data exists but a camera-pixel redistribution grant was not confirmed
statusDefinitions.unknown: No eligible reusable camera feed verified; this is not a finding of no cameras
statusDefinitions.official-linked: Authoritative camera locations on the globe; video opens on the original provider site.
